result.instructions: Tools for Ghost, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which posts are drafts, and when did I last edit each one?"; "Show my paid members who joined in the last 30 days."; "Create a draft post titled 'Q4 release notes' from this outline, with the tags Product and Release.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ghost data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ghost_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ghost_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ghost_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ghost_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ghost_get_site
tools.title: Get site details
tools.description: Get the site title, URL, Ghost version and settings. Use it first to confirm which site is connected. Ghost Admin API: GET /site/.

tools.name: ghost_list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List posts with their status, title, slug, authors and tags. Filter by status with filter, for example "status:draft" or "status:published". Ghost Admin API: GET /posts/.

formats.description: Post body format to return: "html" (default), "lexical", or "html,lexical".

tools.name: ghost_get_post
tools.title: Get a post
tools.description: Get one post by id, including its body and updated_at. Keep updated_at: ghost_update_post needs it. Ghost Admin API: GET /posts/{id}/.

formats.description: Post body format to return: "html" (default), "lexical", or "html,lexical".

tools.name: ghost_list_pages
tools.title: List pages
tools.description: List static pages with their status, title and slug. Ghost Admin API: GET /pages/.

tools.name: ghost_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List post tags with their name, slug and post count. Ghost Admin API: GET /tags/.

tools.name: ghost_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List members (subscribers). Filter with NQL, for example "status:free" (free), "status:-free" (paid), or "subscribed:true". Search by name or email with search. Ghost Admin API: GET /members/.

tools.name: ghost_get_member
tools.title: Get a member
tools.description: Get one member by id: status, email, labels, subscriptions and the last seen time. Ghost Admin API: GET /members/{id}/.

tools.name: ghost_list_tiers
tools.title: List membership tiers
tools.description: List paid membership tiers with their name, status, and optional prices and benefits. Set include to monthly_price,yearly_price,benefits for prices. Ghost Admin API: GET /tiers/.

include.description: Extra fields: monthly_price, yearly_price, benefits (comma separated).

tools.name: ghost_list_newsletters
tools.title: List newsletters
tools.description: List newsletters with their name, status and sender settings. Ghost Admin API: GET /newsletters/.

tools.name: ghost_list_offers
tools.title: List offers
tools.description: List member offers (discounts or trials for paid tiers) with their code, status and redemption type. Ghost Admin API: GET /offers/.

tools.name: ghost_list_labels
tools.title: List member labels
tools.description: List member labels, the segments you use to group members. Ghost Admin API: GET /labels/.

tools.name: ghost_list_users
tools.title: List staff users
tools.description: List staff users (authors and admins) with their role, slug and status. Ghost Admin API: GET /users/.

tools.name: ghost_create_draft_post
tools.title: Create a draft post
tools.description: Create a new post as a DRAFT from HTML. It never publishes and never sends email; publish it in Ghost Admin. Ghost Admin API: POST /posts/?source=html.

html.description: The post body as HTML. Ghost converts it into its own format.

tags.description: Tag names. Ghost finds or creates each tag by name.

tools.name: ghost_update_post
tools.title: Update a post
tools.description: Change a post's title, HTML, excerpt or tags. Pass updated_at from ghost_get_post (Ghost rejects a stale update). It does not change the status and never sends email. An already published post shows the new text at once. Ghost Admin API: PUT /posts/{id}/?source=html.

html.description: The post body as HTML. Ghost converts it into its own format.

tags.description: Tag names. Ghost finds or creates each tag by name.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Ghost
prompts.description: What you can do with Ghost here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_drafts_and_published_posts
prompts.title: Review drafts and published posts
prompts.description: List the posts filtered by status, such as drafts. Open one post to read its body and its last update time.

prompts.name: draft_a_new_post_from_an_outline
prompts.title: Draft a new post from an outline
prompts.description: Read the existing tags first, then create a draft post from HTML. The draft is never published and no email is sent. Publish it in Ghost Admin.

prompts.name: edit_the_text_of_a_post
prompts.title: Edit the text of a post
prompts.description: Read the post to get its update time. Change its title, HTML, excerpt or tags. The status does not change and no email is sent.

prompts.name: check_paid_members_and_tiers
prompts.title: Check paid members and tiers
prompts.description: Filter members by status, such as paid, or search by name or email. Read one member's labels and subscriptions, and list the paid tiers.

prompts.name: list_newsletters_offers_and_labels
prompts.title: List newsletters, offers and labels
prompts.description: List the newsletters, the member offers and the member labels of the site. Labels show how members are grouped.
